items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Who was always in the band then? Lee Collins, Tee Paul, Joe Reni, and myself.

ctx.x: I was. I was. I was. I was. I was. I was. I was. I was. I was in the no-roar. Then my brother used to play soccer for them, but they were good friends. Because my daughter, he couldn't play in no band once they had soccer. He used to work them out in a three and four piece band. You know Jay's, don't you, my brother Jay's a friend of soccer? Well the brother tried to learn about music, but he was hard to learn. And this went on. Them fellas used to help him out. And Lee used to help him out, Lee County. And Lee…
You gotta come take your trink out. Yeah, you know it's water though.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Lee Collins and, um, Lee Collins and, uh, Kid Rene. Oh, Bud Appetite. They all used to go with him on the job.

ctx.x: How long has he been dead? How long has he been dead? My brother must be dead about, um.

You see, my belly, my belly, I'm saying. See, time passed up, but my belly been dead about 23 years. I think Bud died before him. That's why his niece was two years old when my belly died. My brother died, George. You remember my brother George? He was a psycho. He wasn't much a musician, but he was, you know, make out sometimes, you know. He'd take a chance anyway, you know. Just better work, too. Yeah, I was all them boys. Lee Collins and, um, Lee Collins and, uh, Kid Rene. Oh, Bud Appetite. They all used to go…
Did you play with Bud before he was with the Liberty Bell or after?
